subtopics.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea: Cardiovascular and Metabolic Consequences
subtopics.description: Research examining the cardiovascular and metabolic consequences of obstructive sleep apnea, including platelet activation, blood pressure effects, CPAP therapy outcomes, and biomarkers such as NOV and endothelial progenitor cells linked to OSA severity.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular and metabolic effects of obstructive sleep apnea, including blood pressure, platelet activation, and CPAP outcomes.

subtopics.label: Obstructive Sleep Apnea in Special Clinical Populations
subtopics.description: Studies investigating OSA prevalence, risk factors, and outcomes in specific populations including infants, pregnant women, pediatric obesity, thyroid eye disease patients, and surgical patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty.
subtopics.short_description: OSA prevalence, risk factors, and outcomes in infants, pregnant women, pediatric obesity, and surgical patients.

subtopics.label: OSA Treatment: CPAP and Oral Appliance Therapies
subtopics.description: Research evaluating therapeutic interventions for obstructive sleep apnea, including mandibular advancement devices, CPAP efficacy comparisons, and their effects on clinical outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Therapeutic interventions for obstructive sleep apnea, comparing mandibular advancement devices and CPAP on clinical outcomes.

subtopics.label: Sleep Disruption, Neurodegeneration, and Cognitive Decline
subtopics.description: Research linking impaired sleep to neurodegenerative processes including tau deposition, NREM delta power, tauopathy gene networks, and accelerated cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease and related conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Links between impaired sleep, tau deposition, NREM delta power, and accelerated cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease.

subtopics.label: Sleep Disorders in Parkinson's Disease and REM Sleep Behavior Disorder
subtopics.description: Studies on sleep disturbances in Parkinson's disease and isolated REM sleep behavior disorder (iRBD), including light therapy interventions, ambient lighting trials, and neurologic features predicting phenoconversion.
subtopics.short_description: Sleep disturbances in Parkinson's disease and REM sleep behavior disorder, including light therapy and phenoconversion predictors.

subtopics.label: Molecular and Cellular Mechanisms of Circadian Clock Biology
subtopics.description: Research into the molecular underpinnings of circadian rhythms, including the role of TIMELESS in synaptic memory via cAMP signaling, circadian regulation of cell differentiation, and circadian glucocorticoid oscillations driving metabolic dysfunction.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular underpinnings of circadian rhythms, including cAMP signaling, cell differentiation, and glucocorticoid oscillations.

subtopics.label: Wearable Technology and AI for Sleep Monitoring and Disorders
subtopics.description: Studies applying wearable devices and artificial intelligence to detect, monitor, and manage sleep disorders, including scoping reviews of wearable AI for sleep apnea diagnosis and assessment of sleep in hepatic encephalopathy.
subtopics.short_description: Wearable devices and artificial intelligence applied to detection, monitoring, and management of sleep disorders.

subtopics.label: Auditory and Environmental Interventions for Sleep Improvement
subtopics.description: Research evaluating the effects of auditory stimulation (white noise, sound) and environmental factors (extreme heat, ambient lighting) on sleep quality and duration.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of white noise, sound stimulation, extreme heat, and ambient lighting on sleep quality and duration.

subtopics.label: Sleep Management Education in Palliative and Clinical Care Settings
subtopics.description: Studies developing and evaluating educational interventions to improve sleep management knowledge among palliative care and clinical professionals, including online programs and staff training initiatives.
subtopics.short_description: Educational interventions to improve sleep management knowledge among palliative care and clinical professionals.

subtopics.label: Sleep and Mental Health: Psychiatric Disorders and Psychological Well-being
subtopics.description: Research examining the bidirectional relationships between sleep and psychiatric conditions including schizophrenia, depression, and anxiety, as well as the role of bedtime and coping skills in mental health outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Bidirectional relationships between sleep and psychiatric conditions including schizophrenia, depression, and anxiety.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Pandemic Effects on Sleep and Mental Health
subtopics.description: Studies examining how COVID-19 pandemic policies, lockdowns, and long COVID sequelae (including brain fog and PASC subphenotypes) affect sleep patterns, mental health, and child well-being.
subtopics.short_description: Effects of pandemic lockdowns and long COVID sequelae on sleep patterns, mental health, and child well-being.

subtopics.label: Sleep Quality in Chronic Conditions and Comorbidities
subtopics.description: Research investigating sleep quality and its associations with chronic comorbid conditions including tinnitus, cancer in hospitalized children, and musculoskeletal disorders, using both subjective and objective sleep measures.
subtopics.short_description: Associations between sleep quality and chronic conditions including tinnitus, pediatric cancer, and musculoskeletal disorders.

subtopics.label: Sleep Deprivation, Fatigue, and Occupational Safety
subtopics.description: Research on the consequences of sleep restriction and fatigue in occupational contexts, including driving safety impairment among surgical residents and the effects of mild sleep restriction on blood pressure.
subtopics.short_description: Consequences of sleep restriction and fatigue in occupational settings, including driving safety and blood pressure effects.

subtopics.label: Nocturnal Heart Rate Variability and Autonomic Function
subtopics.description: Research examining nocturnal heart rate variability and blood pressure dipping patterns as markers of autonomic dysfunction, including in HIV-positive individuals and pregnant women with anxiety.
subtopics.display_name: Nocturnal Heart Rate Variability & Autonomic Function
subtopics.short_description: Nocturnal heart rate variability and blood pressure dipping as markers of autonomic dysfunction across clinical populations.
